commit: us: keep the distance in 16 bits for the radio frame
title: Ultrasonic reads 0-32 mm whatever is in front of it (16-bit truncation in the distance math), so the arm's start gate never opens

trigger.how: Broken from boot. Point the HC-SR04 at open space more than 200 mm away, so the arm's start gate passes on v1.0 and only the firmware makes it refuse.

name: 07-us-dist-16bit
